admission.justification: Three proving tests pin open, unknown and ambiguous legacy rows; without them an in-progress sprint could archive through a seat-document row.

applicability: Archive admission over legacy seat-document rows.
conditions: Rows commanding masters through seat documents.
exclusions: Typed sprint rows under the separate admission.
statement: Archive admission skips a valid legacy row that commands a master through its seat document, allowing a sprint with that row still inProgress to be archived.
